paragraphs.title: Load the devices.json file into HDFS to test RDDs
paragraphs.text:
%sh

hdfs dfs -mkdir /pruebasRDDs
hdfs dfs -put /home/training/training_materials/dev/data/devices.json /pruebasRDDs
hdfs dfs -cat /pruebasRDDs/devices.json | head -n 10

paragraphs.title: [PYSPARK] - Creating an RDD from a file in HDFS and counting records - (count method)
paragraphs.text:
%pyspark
# Load the JSON file as an RDD of strings
RDD_dispositivos = sc.textFile("hdfs:///pruebasRDDs/devices.json")

# Count the total number of records
total_registros = RDD_dispositivos.count()
print(f"Total number of records: {total_registros}")

# We can see the lineage
# print(RDD_dispositivos.toDebugString().decode('utf-8'))

%pyspark
import json
# convert each JSON string into a Python dictionary

# This creates a new RDD of objects (dictionaries)
# json.loads ("load String")
RDD_parseado = RDD_dispositivos.map(lambda linea: json.loads(linea))

# Display the first 3 elements of the newly created RDD
print("First 3 records")

# RDD_parseado.take(3)

# (Make it look nice)
for registro in RDD_parseado.take(3):
    print(json.dumps(registro, indent=2))

paragraphs.title: [PYSPARK] - filter devices with manufacturer ('make') = 'MeeToo' - (filter method)
paragraphs.text:
%pyspark
# Filter devices whose manufacturer {'make'} is equal to 'MeeToo'
RDD_meetoos = RDD_parseado.filter(lambda dispositivo: dispositivo['make'] == 'MeeToo')

# Count and display the result
recuento_meetoos = RDD_meetoos.count()

print(f"Devices 'MeeToo' found: {recuento_meetoos}")

# collect returns the results to the driver (the controlling program, which is Zeppelin)

# RDD_meetoos.collect()

# (Make it look nice)
for dispositivo in RDD_meetoos.collect():
    print(json.dumps(dispositivo, indent=2))

paragraphs.title: [PYSPARK] - count devices by manufacturer - (map and reduceByKey)
paragraphs.text:
%pyspark

recuento_por_fabricante = (
    
    RDD_parseado.map(lambda dispositivo: (dispositivo['make'], 1))               # map to associate each brand with a value of 1
                .reduceByKey(lambda acumulador, elemento: acumulador + elemento) # reduceByKey to sum the ones
)

# Show all results
print("Device count by manufacturer:")

# recuento_por_fabricante.collect()

# (Make it look nice)
for recuento in recuento_por_fabricante.collect():
    # print(json.dumps(recuento, indent=2))
    print(recuento[0], recuento[1], sep =' => ')

[PYSPARK] - Create an RDD (uncached) and count records - (count method)
paragraphs.text:
%pyspark

import os

# Create an uncached RDD
rdd_sin_cache = sc.textFile("/pruebasRDDs/devices.json")

# Count lines
print("Uncached RDD - count:", rdd_sin_cache.count())

# Create a cached RDD (.cache is a shortcut for .persist(MEMORY_ONLY))
rdd_cacheado = sc.textFile("/pruebasRDDs/devices.json").cache()

# Count lines to load cache
print("Cached RDD - count:", rdd_cacheado.count())

# Show original content
print("Uncached RDD - collect:", rdd_sin_cache.collect())
print('-----------------------------------------------------')
print("Cached RDD - collect:", rdd_cacheado.collect())

paragraphs.title: Delete and recreate the devices.json file in HDFS
paragraphs.text:
%sh

hdfs dfs -rm -skipTrash /pruebasRDDs/devices.json
hdfs dfs -put /home/training/training_materials/dev/data/devices_modificado.json /pruebasRDDs/devices.json
hdfs dfs -cat /pruebasRDDs/devices.json | tail -n 5

paragraphs.title: [PYSPARK] - Check the RDDs again
paragraphs.text:
%pyspark

# Count lines
print("Uncached RDD - count:", rdd_sin_cache.count()) # not cached (re-reads the file from HDFS)

# Count lines to load cache
print("Cached RDD - count:", rdd_cacheado.count())    # cached (does not re-read the HDFS file)

# Show content again
print("Uncached RDD - collect:", rdd_sin_cache.collect())
print('-----------------------------------------------------')
print("Cached RDD - collect:", rdd_cacheado.collect())
